questions.question: Which AWS service is best suited for storing static web assets?
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 is object storage, ideal for static web hosting.

questions.question: Which pricing model lets you pay only for what you use with no upfront commitment?
questions.explanation: On-Demand has no commitment and bills per second/minute of use.

questions.question: Which AWS global infrastructure component is an isolated data center location?
questions.explanation: An Availability Zone is one or more discrete data centers within a Region.

questions.question: Which service centrally manages access permissions for AWS resources?
questions.explanation: IAM controls authentication and authorization for users, groups and roles.

questions.question: Which service provides DDoS protection for applications on AWS?
questions.explanation: AWS Shield (Standard/Advanced) protects against DDoS attacks.
